title: Wetland Wonder ABC
hook: Reeds and wings and water sing!
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: two beats of quiet for retrieval
visualStyle: lush but simple wetland 3D storybook, reeds and water reflections, soft morning light, strong foreground silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: slow dawn walk through reeds, shallow water and bird calls
creativeFingerprint.chorusFunction: calm wonder refrain, not a high-energy reset
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written wetland dawn verse with spacious sensory images, sparse internal rhyme, assonance/consonance, and occasional delayed closure; silence is part of the prosody
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: two-beat recall window then small hand gesture; rare plant names receive unhurried confirmation
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 airy kalimba; chorus gains bass and soft harmony; Round 2 nearly percussion-free
